## Checklist

- [ ] The change was agreed in the issue above, or it's a small fix
- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm check-types` and `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] A changeset, if a published package changes (`pnpm changeset`). It says "Breaking" if a public type or the saved format changes
- [ ] Each new test was seen failing without the change
- [ ] What the docs and the changeset say was checked against the code, not written from memory
- [ ] One behaviour changes. A second one is a second pull request
